why: Drops the opening projection. Invisible to every outcome assertion that reads `outcomePushes.at(-1)` after driving a frame, because the frame's own push overwrites the boot one -- which is exactly why this was uncovered when the projection was introduced, and why the test that kills it counts pushes BEFORE any frame runs. A session disposed before it produces a single event otherwise leaves the HUD describing the previous session's board.
